title: suderra.os-update.v1 device-bound OS update (RAUC bundle) authorization
description: Signed by the edge-provisioning key, pinned in the OS image (ADR-048 DEC-2.9, DEC-3.3, DEC-22, DEC-23). It authorizes one device to install one RAUC bundle into its inactive slot: the bundle is named by digest and size and fetched by root from bundle.url; root verifies this statement, hands the bundle to suderra-ota, and RAUC verifies the bundle's own signature (the RAUC bundle key, ADR-0004) on top. The agent only carries the statement to the update channel (channels.json update_channel). compatible must be the RAUC compatible of the running OS image (boards.json rauc_compatible), so a bundle for another board never installs (DEC-8.3). min_current_version is the oldest OS version the update may start from and rollback_floor the OS version below which the device refuses to go back; root raises its OS rollback floor to rollback_floor only after the health window of the new slot passes (DEC-2.5). supported_agent_abi is the agent ABI range of the new OS: the preflight refuses a bundle whose range excludes the installed agent's agent_abi before anything is written (DEC-23). The acceptance window is the maintenance window (DEC-13.4); RAUC's reboot is scheduled and approved, never spontaneous.

version.description: OS version the bundle installs, as it will read in /etc/os-release VERSION_ID. rollback_floor <= version (checked by the verifier, reported as schema-invalid): a floor above the installed version would forbid the very slot the update installs.

min_current_version.description: The running OS must be at least this version (compared as an integer tuple); below it the update is refused with os-version-too-old.

rollback_floor.description: OS version the device's rollback floor becomes once the new slot is healthy. A device whose floor is already above version refuses the update with rollback-below-floor.

supported_agent_abi.description: Agent ABI range the new OS supports, the value its /etc/os-release will publish as SUDERRA_AGENT_ABI.

update_seq.description: Monotonic per device and payload kind: root keeps the last accepted value in /data/suderra/os/seq/os-update (DEC-2.4).

bundle.description: The RAUC bundle: where root fetches it, its SHA-256 over the whole file and its size. Root compares size and digest of what it fetched with these (artifact-digest-mismatch) and installs from that verified copy, never from a path it re-reads.

local_approval.description: True when root schedules the reboot only after a local operator approval (DEC-13.4); an active alarm or a forced value blocks the update in both cases (maintenance-blocked).

max_outage_seconds.description: Outage budget of the update's reboot, from the shutdown safe-state to the first control tick of the new slot (DEC-2.7, DEC-13.4).
